item.title: Windsor ushers in Year of the Horse with Lunar New Year celebration

item.title: Around Essex County: Cragg no longer CAO of Lakeshore
item.description: Lakeshore and its top bureaucrat have parted ways. Tyson Cragg is no longer chief administrative officer of the Municipality of Lakeshore. “Effective immediately, Lakeshore’s Chief Administrative Officer Tyson Cragg is no longer employed by the Municipality of Lakeshore,” a notice posted on the municipality’s website says. item.title: Police recover $16K in stolen goods following break-in
item.description: Windsor police recovered almost $16,000 in stolen property following a commercial break-and-enter.
